en: The Dyad of Defilements and Factors Associated with Defilements (Kilesakilesasampayuttaduka)

Dependent on a state that is neither a defilement nor dissociated from defilements, there arises a state that is neither a defilement nor dissociated from defilements by way of root condition ... three.

Dependent on a state that is dissociated from defilements but is not a defilement, there arises a state that is dissociated from defilements but is not a defilement by way of root condition ... three.

Dependent on a state that is neither defilement nor dissociated from defilement, and dependent on a state that is both not dissociated from defilement and is itself not defilement, a state that is neither defilement nor dissociated from defilement arises by way of root condition … three. (Abbreviated.
Nine under root; … pe … nine under non-disappearance.
